question: Patient-paired LYPLA1 expression in author malignant ccRCC epithelium versus author normal proximal tubule
selection_criteria: malignant epithelial annotation with CNV context
more independent matched patients than previous n=4 if coverage permits
cell_annotation: Reuse author refined epithelial labels; exact barcode join to full fresh object; no guessed labels or IDs
primary_normalization: per-cell log1p(10000*LYPLA1 counts/full RNA library); aggregate cells within patient and condition
primary_test: two-sided exhaustive paired sign permutation of patient mean difference, up to 20 pairs; Monte Carlo 999999 with plus-one if more
primary_family: one user-specified gene and one primary contrast, q=P; no whole-genome claim
confidence_interval: 95% percentile whole-patient paired bootstrap, 10000 draws; descriptive small-sample uncertainty
sensitivities: equal weight to regions within each patient and condition
tumor cells with author chr3p_loss only
sensitivity_multiplicity: BH over five prespecified sensitivity contrasts separately from primary
leave_one_patient_out: report range of mean effects and exact P, not a new significance criterion
QC: retain author filtering in primary, report mitochondrial fraction, detected genes, UMI, doublet flags and marker summaries without selecting on LYPLA1
patient_fixed_factors: paired design controls time-invariant patient characteristics including sex; no genotype files available for independent identity check
historical_comparison: GSE159115 preserved unchanged; no cross-study cell pooling

selection.selection_rationale: Author final epithelial lineage labels in cell_type8 distinguish ccRCC, other renal tumors and Proximal. Proliferating cells are resolved in this author label rather than dropped by cell_type2. Require independent full-object histology/tissue field simultaneously. Freeze before LYPLA1 effect inspection.
selection.barcode_join: Exact one-to-one; all 64986 refined cells matched full object; patient and sample fields agree; panel raw counts identical
selection.normal_cell_scope: Normal-tissue Proximal only; neither all epithelial cells nor normal-like cells inside tumors
